texts.nma_academy: Kora kandi wige amasomo, afite amasomo arambuye n'impamyabumenyi.
texts.nma_acc: Gumana ibitabo, amafaranga wakoresheje na raporo bifite gahunda.
texts.nma_api: Uko porogaramu zisoma kandi zandika amakuru ya LynkOmni, ku bwumvikane.
texts.nma_assist: Baza ibibazo, ubone ubufasha kandi utegurirwe imishinga y'inyandiko.
texts.nma_attend: Andika abaza n'abagenda: abakozi, abanyeshuri n'abashyitsi.
texts.nma_audit: Inyandiko yuzuye y'uwahinduye iki mu bitabo byawe.
texts.nma_bet: Akira ibitego, sohora amatike kandi wishyure abatsinze ku mukoresha ufite uruhushya.
texts.nma_booking: Fata umwanya w'ingendo, amatike n'amasaha yo guhura ahantu hamwe.
texts.nma_cctv: Reba, fata amashusho kandi ushakishe muri kamera zose z'ahantu hose ahantu hamwe.
texts.nma_chat: Ganira n'abakiriya n'itsinda ryawe ahantu hamwe.
texts.nma_checkout: Ohereza ihuza ryo kwishyura cyangwa werekane kode ya QR kugira ngo wishyurwe.
texts.nma_crm: Kurikirana abakiriya bawe, amasezerano n'ibyo ugomba gukurikirana.
texts.nma_dev: Kora porogaramu zikorana na LynkOmni, ukoresheje API zifunguye n'ibikoresho.
texts.nma_doc: Ubuyobozi n'amakuru yo kubaka ukoresheje LynkOmni.
texts.nma_driver: Ihuza imashini zicapa, izisoma kode n'ibindi bikoresho.
texts.nma_dyna: Ikoresha amafaranga avuye kuri konti yawe bwite.
texts.nma_edge: Ipima ingano porogaramu z'abakora porogaramu zikoresha.
texts.nma_essential: Ishyura fagitire, gura ama inite kandi wongere serivisi za buri munsi.
texts.nma_exchange: Vunja amafaranga hagati y'amafaranga y'ibihugu binyuze ku bafatanyabikorwa bafite uruhushya.
texts.nma_feedback: Tubwire icyo twanoza kandi ukurikirane ibisubizo byacu.
texts.nma_flow: Ikora ibikorwa byawe byikora ishingiye ku bibaye no ku ngengabihe.
texts.nma_gate: Cunga amarembo, bariyeri, aho guhagarika imodoka n'amahoro y'umuhanda ukoresheje impushya n'ubwishyu.
texts.nma_grow: Gera ku bakiriya benshi ukoresheje kwamamaza, poromosiyo n'urupapuro rw'iduka.
texts.nma_guard: Rinda ibinyabiziga n'ibintu by'agaciro ukoresheje ikurikirana n'imenyesha.
texts.nma_hr: Cunga abakozi, ibiruhuko, amasaha y'akazi n'inyandiko z'imishahara.
texts.nma_hub: Aho abakora porogaramu biyandikishiriza porogaramu bagacunga imfunguzo zabo.
texts.nma_id: Umwirondoro wawe muri LynkOmni, umwe kuri buri gikoresho.
texts.nma_inv: Kora kandi wohereze inyemezabuguzi urebe igihe zishyuriwe.
texts.nma_jobs: Tangaza akazi, shaka akazi kandi uhe abantu akazi.
texts.nma_mesh: Ihererekanya ibyagurishijwe hagati y'ibikoresho biri hafi iyo nta interineti.
texts.nma_motion: Kurikirana ibyoherejwe, ingendo n'ibintu byawe buri munsi.
texts.nma_mpay: Akira ikarita, amafaranga kuri telefone n'ubundi bwishyu binyuze ku bafatanyabikorwa bafite uruhushya.
texts.nma_ops: Ibaruramari, inyemezabuguzi, abakiriya n'isesengura muri gahunda imwe.
texts.nma_pos: Gurisha kuri konteri, kuri telefone cyangwa kuri interineti, n'iyo nta interineti ihari.
texts.nma_project: Tegura akazi, sangira inshingano kandi ukurikirane aho bigeze.
texts.nma_proof: Ikusanya ibimenyetso byo gusubiza impaka ku bwishyu.
texts.nma_property: Cunga inzu zikodeshwa, abapangayi, ubukode n'isanwa.
texts.nma_queue: Tanga nimero kandi uhamagare abantu ku murongo, nta kubyigana.
texts.nma_recover: Kurikirana ubwishyu bwananiranye kugira ngo abakiriya bongere bishyure.
texts.nma_rewards: Hemba abakiriya b'indahemuka amanota, poromosiyo n'amakarita y'impano.
texts.nma_safety: Menyesha ikibazo cy'umutekano kandi ubone ubufasha vuba.
texts.nma_school: Cunga ishuri: amashuri, amafaranga y'ishuri, amanota n'ababyeyi.
texts.nma_sdk: Ibikoresho bya kode biteguye byo gukora porogaramu.
texts.nma_split: Igabanya ubwishyu bumwe ku bantu cyangwa ibigo byinshi.
texts.nma_stat: Reba ibyo wagurishije, inyungu n'uko ibintu bigenda ahantu hamwe.
texts.nma_status: Reba niba buri serivisi ikora neza.
texts.nma_stock: Menya ibyo ufite, ibigurwa n'ibyo ugomba kongera gutumiza.
texts.nma_suite: Serivisi zose z'ingenzi muri gahunda imwe ku giciro kimwe.
texts.nma_support: Bona ubufasha ku itsinda ry'ubufasha rya LynkOmni.
texts.nma_survey: Baza ibibazo kandi ukusanye ibisubizo by'ukuri, kuri interineti cyangwa utayifite.
texts.nma_trace: Kurikirana buri komande, ibyoherejwe n'ubusabe intambwe ku yindi.
texts.nma_vcard: Amakarita yo gukoresha, atangwa n'umufatanyabikorwa ufite uruhushya.
texts.nma_vote: Kora amatora atekanye ku itsinda iryo ari ryo ryose.
